description: Vlaams Instituut voor Zee: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. Coverage: Vlaams Instituut voor Zee. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cycle de vie et production de Canuella perplexa (Copepoda, Harpacticoi; Résumé des études benthiques sur le quai d'écluse d'Ostende entre 1976; Eurytemora affinis dans le quai de l'écluse d'Ostende (1970-1971). Formats seen: DWCA. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
